newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Jude Medical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Jude Medical started.

text.p: -- Dillon, Read & Co analysts Matthew Dodds III and Raul Esquivel started coverage of St. Jude Medical Inc Tuesday with a rating of buy.
-- They set a 12-month price target of $52 on the stock.
-- "After the company goes through a 'transition year' in 1997, we are looking for earnings to rise sharply in 1998.

-- "In light of St. Jude's recent weakness, we would encourage investors to establish or add to current positions as we believe the stock is poised to significantly outperform the market over the next 18 months."
-- Shares in the Minneapolis cardiovascular devices company closed Monday at 35-3/8.
